steps.text:
The bike cellar in building C closes for renovation from Monday 4 May to Friday 22 May. All bikes must be removed by Sunday 3 May, 18:00. Temporary racks for 40 bikes stand behind the canteen, ready for use. Bikes left in the cellar after the deadline will be moved to the depot at Ostring 12, for collection with a staff badge. For questions, please contact the facility desk, extension 4410.
